# Nothing Stuck, Nothing Merged

Version 0.12.3 fixes items that could stay stuck or vanish, a channel description that showed raw HTML, and a card that stayed empty when the browser blocks site data.

## Items

- **An item no longer gets stuck open but empty.** _[#81]_ Closing an item while its image was still loading left it marked as open at zero height, and every later tap only "closed" it again until you reloaded the page. Such an item now closes at once and opens again on the next tap.
- **Entries that share a link stay apart.** _[#81]_ The card told entries apart by their link and published date, so entries with the same link and no published date, as in status feeds or Atom feeds that only carry an updated date, collapsed into one. The card now uses the entry's id from the feed first, and falls back to the link with the published or updated date. Existing bookmarks are still found.
- **`open_behavior: latest` works when the feed loads late.** _[#81]_ The newest item was only opened on the first render, so after a Home Assistant restart, before the first poll, nothing was opened once the entries arrived. The card now opens the newest item as soon as there is one, once, and does not reopen it after you close it.

## Channel info

- **An HTML channel description is shown as text.** _[#81]_ The description or subtitle of a feed often contains HTML, and the card showed it with its literal tags, and the truncation could cut a tag in half. The tags now come off before truncating, and the bodies of script and style elements are dropped instead of being shown as code.
- **The editor offers the channel date for more feeds.** _[#81]_ The "show published date" switch only appeared when the channel carried a published date, and picking the entity removed the setting again, although the card itself also shows the updated date that RSS `lastBuildDate` and Atom feeds use. The editor now checks the same dates as the card, so the switch appears and the setting is kept.

## Fixes

- **The card renders when the browser blocks site data.** _[#81]_ With site data blocked, every access to the browser's local storage throws, and the bookmark check did not catch that, so the card stayed empty even with bookmarks off. The items now render as not bookmarked, and the error goes to the console.

## Upgrading

Nothing to change in your card configuration. Bookmarks saved with earlier versions keep working.
